title: Design: the New Category name error keeps the columns in place
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts' and 'See Financial Data'.
  • Use a desktop browser window exactly 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so the screen matches the design pictures' size.
custom_steps:
1. Open Settings › Categories.
  2. Click New Category.
  3. Take a screenshot of the page.
  4. Click the blue button at the top right.
  5. Take a second screenshot of the page.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The Categories list shows.

Step 2:

  • The New Category page shows its grid.

Step 3:

  • The screenshot shows the grid headings.

Step 4:

  • The red "Name is a required field" line shows under the name.

Step 5:

  • Compared with the first screenshot, the grid's headings Cost Range, Default and the tiers keep the same left-right place; the grid only moves down by the height of the red line, as pictures 8.6 and 8.7 show.
  • The grid shows the same rows as before.
